recognize_zh: 高倍下數個大型母細胞核內有一塊淡染、邊界清楚的核凹陷區（nuclear invagination），使細胞核呈杯狀（cup-like），凹陷處面積超過核的四分之一，染色質細緻、細胞質藍色無顆粒，是 NPM1 突變 AML 的特徵性形態。
features: Large blasts with a high N:C ratio and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Cup-like nuclei: a sharply demarcated pale invagination at one pole occupying more than 25% of the nuclear area
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Agranular cytoplasm without visible Auer rods
Background red cells and a platelet in a smear preparation
describe_en: The smear shows several large blasts with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a narrow rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Many blasts display a sharply outlined, pale nuclear invagination at one side of the nucleus that occupies more than a quarter of the nuclear area, giving a cup-like or fish-mouth appearance. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with cup-like blasts, which are strongly associated with AML with NPM1 mutation, frequently with concurrent FLT3-ITD; mutation testing is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL blasts have bilobed or butterfly-shaped folded nuclei and faint granules with PML::RARA, whereas cup-like blasts have a round nucleus with a single pale invagination.
Promonocytes show delicately folded, convoluted nuclei with gray cytoplasm and fine granules and are NSE positive, rather than a discrete cup-shaped invagination.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with nuclear clefts
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and small nuclear clefts, and flow shows TdT with B/T lineage markers, whereas cup-like AML blasts are CD34-negative myeloid blasts.
Artifactual clearing is irregular and affects cells unevenly, whereas cup-like invaginations are sharply demarcated and repeated across many blasts.
